correctness.rationale: Read source Cheng’s actual local perturbation construction and geodesic-integral proof. Independently reconstructed the four-dimensional quadratic matrix P and its 256 second-derivative curvature components using SymPy, verifying Ric(P)=0 and squared Riemann-tensor norm 144 at origin (16 nonzero components), so amplitude a_j with ε_j=e^{-j/a_j} produces exact norm 12j. For fixed j, the uniform curvature envelope E_{a,j}(r)<=2C(j+1) but E_{a,j}(r)->0 for every r>0 as a->0; finite-valued gauge continuity at zero plus dominated convergence makes each fixed gauge integral vanish in this limit. A finite-at-each-stage diagonal choice of a_j satisfies first j gauge energies <2^{-j}, giving all countably many global integrals. Disjoint supports preserve C¹/Ricci controls; Cheng’s uniform geodesic-residence estimate and Proposition5.2 yield inj>0 even though pointwise Rm is unbounded. At scalar-flat peaks the Gauss identity |A|²=16|H|² and |Rm|<=2|A|² yields |H|²>=3j/8. No finite computation is invoked as an infinite proof; the key imported geodesic lemma was checked in primary text.
